setup.categoryHint: Guests book a category, such as Compact or SUV.

guide.locationNameText: Guests pick it when they book, so use a name they know, such as “Tirana Airport”.
guide.locationAddressText: Choose the country and city, then the street. Guests see this address when they book, so they know where to collect the car.
guide.locationPickupText: Leave this on so guests can collect cars here. Online booking needs at least one place to pick up.
guide.locationHoursText: Guests can pick up and return cars only inside these hours. Leave them empty if you're open around the clock.
guide.categoryNameText: The name guests choose when they book, such as “Economy” or “Family SUV”.
guide.categoryPhotosText: Guests choose with their eyes. Add a few clear photos of a car from this category.
guide.categoryRateText: What one day costs. Online booking works out each booking's price from it.
guide.categoryDepositText: What you hold as a guarantee when a car is picked up. Guests see it before they book.
guide.categoryPublicText: Leave this on so guests can book this category online.
guide.vehicleCategoryText: Guests who book this category can get this car.
guide.vehiclePlateText: How your team tells your cars apart, in the planner and at the counter.
guide.vehicleHomeText: Where the car is usually kept. Guests picking up there get the cars already on site first.
guide.vehicleStatusText: Only active cars are rented out. Change the status when a car goes to the garage or leaves your fleet.

tour.counter: Today's desk: the cars going out and the cars coming back. Hand them over and take them back here.
tour.planner: Every car on one timeline, with its bookings and blocks. See at a glance which cars are free.
tour.reservations: Every booking, from your website or made by your team. Change or cancel one from its menu.
tour.vehicles: Your cars, with their category, home location and status. Only active cars are rented out.
